text: Attempt 4: attempt 2's fast compact bands + attempt 3's un-zoned power columns + separate taxes (homes 5%, shops 4%, factories 3%) + a fire station in every block + a cash reserve.
Day one: $10,000 bond, neighbor link, block 1 (6 streets, 4 cross streets, power columns linked on y=56), homes/shops/factories bands, coal plant, 12 wired pumps, pipe main x=74, fire station.
Second bond. Block 2 south (y56-90) with power columns, second coal plant (x102-105, y70-73), police station, 11 more pumps, pipes.
Third bond: 43-pump field at the river bend wired with two power-line rows (all pumps powered). Block 3 east (x109-126, y20-55).
Home tax 5% -> 8% (home demand maxed; loan payments exceeded tax income). Fourth bond.
Third coal plant by the river (x64-67, y57-60), line to the power column x=77. Speed-up: DOSBox now draws fewer frames, the game runs about 3x faster.
Fifth bond. Fourth coal plant (x60-63, y57-60), 33 more pumps wired with a power-line row (y=52). Block 3 south with a second fire station.
Sixth bond; taxes homes 10%, shops 4%, factories 4%. Block 4 south (y91-124) with every band zoned (jobs next to all homes), power columns linked on y=125, pipes, fire and police stations.
Seventh bond; shop tax 4% -> 6%. Fifth coal plant (x56-59, y57-60) and 34 more pumps on a third wired row (y=55).
Taxes homes 12%, shops 7%, factories 5%. Ordinances: legalized gambling (+$104/yr), parking fines (+$71/yr), volunteer fire department (-$47/yr, helps against fires).
Eighth bond. Block 5 southeast (x109-126, y91-124): all bands zoned, power columns, pipes, third fire station.
Test: dense housing on empty lots in block 5 (y119-123, x118-123).
Ninth bond. North district (y1-19): dense homes and dense shops by the lakes, power columns linked across street 20, pipes, fourth fire station.
